instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium close-up at eye-level with a shallow depth of field. On a warm outdoor patio, the woman in the grey long-sleeve shirt (R1) on the left leans in very close to the young woman in the floral dress (R2) on the right. They are positioned nose-to-nose, with the woman (R1) looking affectionately at the young woman (R2), who looks back. The woman (R1) keeps her right hand resting gently on the young woman's (R2) shoulder. The scene is bathed in warm, natural daylight, highlighting their close, loving bond.
